In the figure, the upper side of S2 is aligned with the lower side of R2, and the lower side of S2 is aligned with the lower side of S1 and the upper side of R1; the upper side of S3 is also aligned with the lower side of R2, and extends all the way to the bottom side. Let the side length of S1 be a, the side length of S2 be b, the side length of S3 be d, and the height of R2 be h. Because S2 goes from the bottom of R2 to the bottom of S1, b = a - h. Because S3 goes from the bottom of R2 to the bottom of the large rectangle, and the height of the large rectangle is 2020, d = 2020 - h. In the horizontal direction, the total width of the large rectangle is composed of the sum of the widths of S1, S2, and S3, therefore 3322 = a + b + d. From b = a - h, we get a = b + h, and d = 2020 - h; substituting gives 3322 = (b + h) + b + (2020 - h) = 2020 + 2b. So 2b = 1302, b = 651. Therefore the side length of S2 is 651.
